sections.heading: History
sections.text:
All four pilots were sent with two choppers to prevent the Huntik Foundation team from landing in Vienna. Dante Vale and Zhalia Moon stopped them by summonning Metagolem and King Basilisk directly onto the choppers, leading them to crash down. [The Bookshop Hunter]

Under Wilder's reign, Unnamed Organization Pilot 002 and Unnamed Organization Pilot 004, accompanied by Unnamed Suit 055 and Unnamed Suit 058; were sent to attack the team while they were travelling to Tower of Nostradamus in France. Despite the use of Targetfind, the missils were tricked by Zhalia Moon's Thoughtspecter illusion, and the chopper was subsequently destroyed by the team's spells. The pilots and Suits ejected before the explosion. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

== History ==
All four pilots were sent with two choppers to prevent the [[Huntik Foundation]] team from landing in [[:Category:Vienna, Austria|Vienna]]. [[Dante Vale]] and [[Zhalia Moon]] stopped them by summonning [[Metagolem]] and [[King Basilisk]] directly onto the choppers, leading them to crash down. {{source|The Bookshop Hunter}}

Under [[Wilder]]'s reign, Unnamed Organization Pilot 002 and Unnamed Organization Pilot 004, accompanied by [[Unnamed Suit 055]] and [[Unnamed Suit 058]]; were sent to attack the team while they were travelling to [[Tower of Nostradamus]] in France. Despite the use of [[Targetfind]], the missils were tricked by [[Zhalia Moon]]'s [[Thoughtspecter]] illusion, and the chopper was subsequently destroyed by the team's spells. The pilots and Suits ejected before the explosion. {{source|The Tower of Nostradamus}}
